The `package()` function installs built binaries and assets into standard system directories with appropriate permissions.

There is no obfuscated code, suspicious scripting, or use of dangerous commands like `curl|bash`, `eval`, or runtime downloads. All operations are confined to the source directory and follow standard AUR packaging practices. The package does not modify system files outside its scope or install hooks that could pose a security risk. While the use of `bun` and AOT compilation may be less common in traditional packaging, they are part of the upstream project's toolchain and not inherently malicious.
</details>
